messages:
mira (CS): Quick alert 9:10 UTC 9:48 UTC window: Console progress badges for several EU trial tenants stopped updating. Not seeing onboarding-step webhooks in CS automation. tagging eng/support for root cause + customer comms.
sanjay (AE): which tenants? I have 4 renewal conversations next week and need to know exposure.
anya (Eng): investigating. early signal shows our metrics-consumer lagged after a transient spike reconnecting to the event queue. looks like consumer workers entered a retry hot-loop and backpressure prevented downstream acknowledgement. not model or data loss.
rafa (Support): immediate hits: horizon-marketing, nova-labs, and three trial sandboxes. horizon had hit the "setup complete" state but the console didn't flip so the enablement runbook didn't trigger.
mira (CS): that matches a support ticket from horizon earlier. we should be proactive with these tenants and offer immediate live assist + onboarding credit. template please.
anya (Eng): short-term mitigation: bumped consumer backoff + set fail-open flag so event emitters will surface UI-safe fallbacks. deploying a hotfix now. ETA for rollout 10 -> 100%: 12m.
deploy-bot: New deploy initiated by anya: telemetry-consumer-failopen v2.0. roll 0.1 -> 1.0 over 12m.
rafa (Support): can we prepare a CS note that is non-technical, lists impact, and gives clear next steps? also we should include a way for customers to mark if they're mid-onboarding or within renewal window.
mira (CS): draft: "Hello — today between 09:10 and 09:48 UTC some EU trial customers saw onboarding progress indicators in the Console not update. Your data and product usage were unaffected. Weve applied a fix and are replaying missed events so progress will appear shortly. If you were in the middle of an onboarding session reply and well schedule a live enablement within 48 hours. If your renewal is within 30 days reply RENEW-PRIORITY and well escalate a 1:1 and offer a complimentary onboarding week. Apologies for the interruption." Feedback?
sanjay (AE): add an explicit ask to DM me if they'd like the 1:1 tied to the renewal; gives me a channel to rescue deals. Also include reference to a scheduled office hour.
mira (CS): added. office hour tomorrow 15:00 UTC for impacted tenants. anya 9: how long to finish event replay and confirm console counts align?
anya (Eng): replay started, consumer watermark advancing. estimate 25-35m to catch up fully for the affected shards. verification steps: 1) consumer-watermark >= last-event-ts 2) console counts === raw-events for sample tenants 3) no OOMs in worker logs. will update when done.
rafa (Support): building CSV with impacted tenants, renewal dates, severity tier, and owner. will upload link in thread.
mira (CS): plan: 1) send customer note once fix is 100% rolled and replay verified, 2) targeted DM/outreach for renewal-risk accounts, 3) apply one-week onboarding credit, 4) invite to office hour + follow-up survey.
deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% complete. status -> DEPLOYED.
anya (Eng): replay complete for listed shards. ran verification checklist: `curl -s https://internal.telemetry/health | jq .consumer_watermark` -> shows advanced timestamp; `grep -i oom /var/log/consumer.log` -> no matches. marking incident as mitigated.
mira (CS): posting final external note now (short). copy below for review: 
---
Hi there — were following up about an onboarding visibility gap affecting some EU trial accounts between 09:109:48 UTC today. This impacted Console progress indicators and CS automation only; your data and product functionality were not affected. Weve deployed a fix and replayed missed events; most Consoles should now show correct progress. If this interrupted an active onboarding, reply and well arrange a live assist within 48 hours. If your renewal is within 30 days, reply RENEW-PRIORITY and well prioritize a 1:1 and provide a complimentary one-week onboarding credit. Were scheduling an office hour tomorrow at 15:00 UTC for any impacted teams. Apologies for the disruption and thanks for your patience.
---

sanjay (AE): approved. Im DMing horizon-marketing and nova-labs.
rafa (Support): upload: https://intranet.redwood/cs/onboard-visibility-5090012345.csv (tenant, renewal, owner).
mira (CS): follow-ups: apply credits, send invites, and include Enablement Survey link in the follow-up email. please update when done.
rafa (Support): credits applied to horizon-marketing and nova-labs; confirmation email sent to horizon-support.
mira (CS): closing the loop here. if any tenant still reports Console mismatch, add to thread and well triage. thanks team :pray:
